text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa takes first place! She
kept her
word and defeated the condor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Nakayama Festa has overcome a
huge
hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...This isn't a dream.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's really not a dream! Nakayama Festa
is
capable of beating El Condor Pasa's
record!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let's give them another round of
applause.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There isn't an Umamusume alive who
hasn't
dreamed of running beyond the
horizon, as far as
the sky reaches.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And yet so many throw in the towel,
dismissing it
as just a childish fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But today, one brave Umamusume has
shown us
the magic of persevering.

text_block_list.name: Past Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Japan's El Condor Pasa closes in from
behind. She
inches forward! Is she about
to take the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Past Commentator
text_block_list.text:
No! El Condor Pasa fails to overcome the

international barrier,
finishing in a close
second!

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I really thought El Condor Pasa
was gonna
win there for a second!

text_block_list.name: Local B
text_block_list.text:
There's always next year's Prix de l'Arc
de
Triomphe! We're getting so much
closer!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Her story inspired people. And a trend
soon
followed.

text_block_list.name: Past Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And Manhattan Cafe crosses the finish
line from
behind! Japan's dream is
postponed yet again!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer
text_block_list.text:
Aw, and she was in such a good spot...
But things are looking up! We just need
someone more like
El Condor Pasa to
come around.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The more and more Umamusume chased
that
dream—

text_block_list.name: Past Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She gave it a good chase, but she was
just a little
bit too slow! Once again,
Japan's hero has failed
to conquer!

text_block_list.name: Businessman A
text_block_list.text:
Another loss. I thought for sure we'd get
it this
time...

text_block_list.name: Businessman B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should just take pride in what
El
Condor Pasa managed to accomplish.
Come on,
let's go home.

text_block_list.name: Businessman A
text_block_list.text: If only she could've won back then...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—the further they drifted from the
dream, and the more despondent
people became. What was just
within
reach becomes a dried up memory.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Until it no longer seems possible at all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But what point does anything have if we
forget
our capacity to dream?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Nakayamaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it feel invigorating to dream the

impossible? To laugh in the face of
reason? To
shine bright?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Raise your voices and let out a cheer!
We are the
ones who will carve our path
forward!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heheh... Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That was rough...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha. Get over here. Look at this...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The sky's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stand next to Nakayama Festa and look
up at the sky. Just as she says, it
somehow appears
more beautiful than
normal.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the sky is this beautiful
there
too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... I can't wait.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure it'll look exceptio...
Yeah, I'm sure it'll look exceptio...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Right. If I turn out the loser,
what would I
care how the sky looks?
choice_data_list: But only the victor has the privil...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, mind lending me your
shoulder?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I can barely move. Seems that my
legs are
outta gas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa puts her arm around my

shoulder, and I slowly lift her back on
her feet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is what greatness looks like.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It really takes your everything to reach
out and
steal victory. I wonder if a year
will be enough
time.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course it will.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm?! ...El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As expected, you surpassed me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You've taken your first step towards
being the first to reach that goal. I'm
sure you'll be able to
deliver victory to
your loved ones.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You never shed a tear or hung your head
in
disappointment! You shook everything
off...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hold on a sec...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on? This is no place...
to be
crying...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You staked your dream against me.
You chose
that for me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, I had to do it.
I had to give it my all, because
you were doing the same. You
gave me the ability
to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, the ticket for the place you
wanted to go is
in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thank you, El.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is only just the beginning. You've
taught me
about the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
With this ticket, I'm going to the top.
Surpassing
you has only set me on that
path.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...That's the spirit! You've got a lot of
hard
training ahead of you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Go out there and win in my place!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Count on me. I'm gonna win big for all of
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The doors to the future have opened
before us.
